text: 【中国人民银行行长潘功胜出席二十国集团财长和央行行长会议】2026年10月15日，二十国集团（G20）在泰国曼谷召开今年第三次G20财长和央行行长会议。会议讨论了全球经济形势与展望、金融部门改革等议题。中国人民银行行长潘功胜出席会议并发言，中国人民银行副行长宣昌能参加会议。潘功胜指出，地缘政治冲突加剧仍是全球经济的最大不确定性。一些国家国债市场大幅波动、人工智能相关资产估值回调风险加剧了金融脆弱性。
text_en: [PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng attends the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting] On October 15, 2026, the G20 held its third G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting of the year in Bangkok, Thailand. The meeting discussed the global economic situation and outlook, financial sector reform, and other topics. PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng attended the meeting and delivered remarks, and PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng also attended. Pan Gongsheng pointed out that intensifying geopolitical conflicts remain the biggest uncertainty for the global economy. Sharp fluctuations in some countries' government bond markets and rising risk of valuation corrections in AI-related assets have exacerbated financial fragility.
